issue.title: Cmd+1..9 inserts the Nth idle-agenda link into the capture draft
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-66.7 note #3 (epic bob-cli-66 closeout follow-up, triaged by bob-cli-66.land). With the idle agenda showing, Cmd+1 through Cmd+9 insert the Nth agenda Task Link (in the numbering bob reports) into the draft, so a user can reference a queued task without retyping it. The number-to-link mapping must come from bob's capture-pomodoros --tasks payload, and the shortcuts must not collide with existing panel shortcuts.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan plan:202610/idle_capture_pomodoro_agenda.md (epic bob-cli-66) settled the v1.1 agenda interactions as out of scope: keyboard focus never leaves the editor and rows are read-only in v1. The accepted decision decisions:idle-capture-shows-ledger-agenda lists row clicks, keyboard navigation, and ⌘1…9 insertion under 'Reopens when', so this work should revisit that record.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-66.7 recorded this v1.1 agenda interaction as a follow-up; v1 keeps keyboard focus in the editor and the agenda read-only.
